publication_conditions: Keep the PR in draft state; do not mark ready or merge while remote required checks and security findings are unavailable.
Do not suppress or reclassify missing/failing required checks, and do not report unavailable security services as PASS.
Resume ordinary readiness and merge gates only after required checks and security review become available and pass, or the owner explicitly changes authority.
basis: docs/implementation/github-sync.md records owner authorization for ordinary pushes and PR creation and requires required checks, CodeQL/security findings, independent review and mergeability to be checked before draft readiness or merge.
The repository remains private, so draft publication remains within the existing private repository context.

The exact-head independent security/license review is APPROVED, local Gitleaks findings were classified without observing an actual credential, and the exact-head source snapshot was verified against committed blob bytes.
A draft PR is not a readiness or merge decision; required unavailable gates remain blocking.
